Definition: a Zarchite or descendant of Zerach
BiblicalUsage: Zarchiy names the Zarhites, the descendants of Zerah, counted among the tribes in the wilderness census. In Joshua's day the family of the Zarhites is brought forward lot by lot until Achan is found, and the sin hidden in one household is laid bare before all Israel.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a family name carries both honour and warning, because what one member hides can stain the whole house.
